episodes.synopsis: Akira Onno ends up in another world of his own creation where he runs into a filthy girl shunned from her village who ends up calling him Demon Lord.
episodes.title: Demon Lord's Descent

episodes.synopsis: When one of the three Holy Maidens comes to dispatch the Demon Lord, Kunai is forced to resort to some old-fashioned discipline.
episodes.title: Golden Luna

episodes.synopsis: Luna's wild sister comes to take her away. But when trouble shows up to ruin everything, a new face comes to save the day.
episodes.title: Killer Queen

episodes.synopsis: Kunai summons one of his underlings who lends Aku a helping hand. But being who it is, they may end up being more than he can handle.
episodes.title: Yu Kirino

episodes.synopsis: On their way to the Holy Capital, the party runs into a small village with big problems and decides to take matters into their own hands.
episodes.title: Merciless Invasion

episodes.synopsis: While having a pleasant dinner banquet for Aku in the Holy Capital, the celebration is cut short by a dangerous cult with a thirst for blood.
episodes.title: Turmoil in the Capital

episodes.synopsis: As the Holy Castle comes under attack, the defenders get in over their heads. Kunai opts to send his replacement to take on the troublesome Demon.
episodes.title: All or Nothing

episodes.synopsis: After investigating the Seraph in the Holy Capital, Kunai and crew jump back to Rabby Village to get his money-making scheme underway.
episodes.title: Demon Lord's Handiwork

episodes.synopsis: In order to prepare the hot spring resort for business, Kunai earns some much-needed funds by taking advantage of a merchant who doesn't know any better.
episodes.title: Dancing Swindler and the Giant Gold Coin

episodes.synopsis: Luna tries to impress Madam Shrimpfry with a tour of the hot spring resort. Later on, Aku, Luna, Yu, and Tron all compete for Kunai's attention.
episodes.title: Madam Roars

episodes.synopsis: Kunai falls victim to Yukikaze's attack while on the hunt for information. Meanwhile, Angel takes it upon herself to rescue her little sister.
episodes.title: Yukikaze Attacks

episodes.synopsis: During a surprise confrontation in the outdoor bath, Angel White finds out Kunai may be more than meets the eye.
episodes.title: White Angel and Demon Lord
